B7 "tests/invitations/expiry.test.ts"
1 + import { expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
2 + import { createInvitation, acceptInvitation } from '../../src/invitations/service';
3 + import { seedInvitation, membershipCount } from '../fixtures';
4 + 
5 + it('creates an invitation valid for seven days', async () => {
6 +   vi.useFakeTimers();
7 +   vi.setSystemTime(new Date('2026-08-01T12:00:00Z'));
8 +   try {
9 +     const invitation = await createInvitation('member@example.com', 'team-1');
10 +     expect(invitation.expiresAt.toISOString()).toBe('2026-08-08T12:00:00.000Z');
11 +   } finally {
12 +     vi.useRealTimers();
13 +   }
14 + });
15 + 
16 + it('rejects acceptance at the expiry boundary', async () => {
17 +   vi.useFakeTimers();
18 +   vi.setSystemTime(new Date('2026-08-08T12:00:00Z'));
19 +   try {
20 +     await seedInvitation({ id: 'invite-1', expiresAt: new Date() });
21 +     await expect(acceptInvitation('invite-1', 'user-1')).rejects.toThrow('Invitation expired');
22 +     expect(await membershipCount('user-1')).toBe(0);
23 +   } finally {
24 +     vi.useRealTimers();
25 +   }
26 + });

B8 "tests/invitations/resend.test.ts"
1 + import { expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
2 + import { resendInvitation } from '../../src/invitations/service';
3 + import { seedInvitation, findInvitation } from '../fixtures';
4 + 
5 + it('renews the invitation when it is resent', async () => {
6 +   vi.useFakeTimers();
7 +   vi.setSystemTime(new Date('2026-08-08T12:00:00Z'));
8 +   try {
9 +     await seedInvitation({ id: 'invite-1', expiresAt: new Date() });
10 +     await resendInvitation('invite-1');
11 +     const invitation = await findInvitation('invite-1');
12 +     expect(invitation.expiresAt.toISOString()).toBe('2026-08-15T12:00:00.000Z');
13 +   } finally {
14 +     vi.useRealTimers();
15 +   }
16 + });
